Kiosk._comment: Server-side proxy to the ShiftKiosk server. ServiceToken is a device token issued by tools/admin_cli.py device enroll --hostname pulse-backend. It never reaches a browser and is revocable per device.

Auth._comment: EnforceAuthorization: false = login works but nothing is blocked (rollout phase). Set true ONLY after a DEV login is proven over BOTH the https devtunnel URL and http://localhost:5000. See documentation/auth_rbac.md.

Rules._comment: Rule-engine thresholds (Features:RulesEngine). Read through IOptionsMonitor, so a change takes effect without a restart.
